x: Frank Wright was first home in the good time of 21 min. 27 secs., closely followed by Darchambaud, of the School, and this lad was at one time on our books, but has since joined South London H., and is running very well for them.

I have just completed my first winter season over here, competing in four of the five league matches, and I couldn't help making comparisons, as surely Darchambaud of S.L.H., and George Knight of Essex Beagles must have done; they turned out for Chelmsford and Brentwood respectively while I ran for Southend.

This earned him the second fastest time of the day, surpassed only by Darchambaud who was 3 sec. faster. It was however, a Belgrave best and was only 12 sec. outside the stage record held by none other than Ken Norris.
In the mile John Thresher ran particularly well to gain third place in 4:26.0 behind Pegley and Darchambaud (S.L.H.) 4:23.0 and finish in front of Mal Robinson.
